overview_description.description: Shipa is a digital logistics platform that provides end-to-end shipping, e-commerce fulfillment, and last-mile delivery solutions for businesses and consumers. It enables users to manage freight, deliveries, and returns online with tracking and automation tools. Operating across the GCC and beyond, it supports cross-border trade and supply chain efficiency.

product.name: Shipa Delivery
product.description: A last-mile and on-demand delivery service operating across the GCC, offering same-day, next-day, and scheduled deliveries with real-time tracking and support for various parcel types.

product.name: Shipa Freight
product.description: A digital freight forwarding platform that manages international shipping logistics, including air, sea, and road freight, with online booking and shipment tracking.

product.name: Shipa Ecommerce Fulfillment
product.description: E-commerce order fulfillment services including warehousing, inventory management, and distribution across the GCC region.

product.name: Shipa Mall
product.description: An online platform that simplifies international e-commerce shopping for GCC consumers by managing purchases and shipping logistics.
